title: Auto mode refuses to edit ~/.claude/settings.json or copy secrets even when asked
symptoms: Denied as Self-Modification when adding allow rules
Denied when copying values out of a secret store into a local file
cause: Auto mode will not widen its own permissions or materialize secrets on its own, even with the user's request in the conversation.
fix: Have the user run the change: give a ready-to-run command that backs up the file first, then continue after it has run. Keep secrets in a chmod 600 file the scripts read at runtime.
